proposals.before: In 756, the first year of Zhide, a Huainan circuit military commissioner was created, commanding thirteen prefectures—Yang, Chu, Chu, He, Shou, Lu, Shu, Guang, Qi, An, Huang, Shen, and Mian—from his seat at Yang Prefecture.
proposals.after: In 756, the first year of Zhide, a Huainan circuit military commissioner was created, commanding thirteen prefectures—Yang, Chu, Chu (滁), He, Shou, Lu, Shu, Guang, Qi, An, Huang, Shen, and Mian—from his seat at Yang Prefecture.
proposals.reason: Chu and Chu (滁) are two different prefectures, but the idiomatic English renders both as Chu.
